items.title: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Duolingo, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - DUOL
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Duolingo, Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased Class A common stock between May 2, 2025 and February 26, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Duolingo made materially false statements regarding Daily Active User growth rates, failed to disclose that increased user friction from ads and subscription upsells was negatively impacting DAU growth, and concealed that AI-generated content was degrading product quality and user experience. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is December 7, 2026.

items.title: DUOL INVESTOR ALERT: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP Files Class Action Lawsuit Against Duolingo, Inc. and Announces Opportunity for Investors with Substantial Losses to Lead the Duolingo Class Action Lawsuit
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Duolingo, Inc. alleging that the company made false statements about Daily Active User growth while deliberately adding friction through increased ads and subscription upsells. The lawsuit covers stock purchases between May 2, 2025 and February 26, 2026. Duolingo's stock declined significantly following revelations of slowing DAU growth (from 49% to 30%) and a strategic shift away from monetization, with stock falling 25%, 8.5%, and 14% on three separate disclosure dates.
